fact: INTIC states Mozambique's data protection bill, approved by the Council of Ministers this year, is under review in the Assembly of the Republic and that Mozambique is outside the African network of authorities until the law is approved.
title: INTIC acompanha avanços da Rede Africana de Autoridades de Protecção de Dados e reforça compromisso com a futura adesão de Moçambique
